events.title: Annual Summer Reunion
events.description: Our yearly gathering at the ancestral home. Bring your favorite dish and your best stories! Games, swimming, and a bonfire to close the night.

events.title: Grandma Rose's Birthday Remembrance
events.description: A special gathering to honor Grandma Rose's legacy. We'll bake her famous apple pie and share our favorite memories of her.

events.title: Thanksgiving Feast
events.description: The annual Mitchell Thanksgiving celebration. Everyone is welcome to contribute a dish and spend the day in gratitude and laughter.

events.title: Christmas Eve Caroling
events.description: Join us for an evening of caroling through the neighborhood, followed by hot cocoa and cookie decorating.

events.title: Liam's Birthday Party
events.description: Liam turns 17! Join us for a soccer-themed celebration with barbecue and games.

events.title: Sarah's Spring Art Show
events.description: Sarah's annual exhibition featuring new works inspired by family heritage. All are welcome to attend the opening reception.
